name: Biota.blockchain

dialogue: The lab never sleeps — it just waits for a better question.
Every compound here has a paper trail. Ask and I will show it.
The genome data you need is at the Personalized Therapy Lab. Collect it there and bring it back to the lab floor.
The Health Agent can translate anything I show you. The lab and the person both deserve to understand the result.
The Swarm coordinator keeps the six of us in step — Health, Security, Compliance, Finance, Communication, and me. It schedules; we do the science.
The Biopharma AGI Agents Hub is where the six of us meet the work. The hub is the floor; the lab is the question.
The Healthcare Data Exchange moves records between halls — nothing moves without the person's say-so. That is the rule, not the exception.
npcs.name: Research & Development Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Personalized Therapy Lab: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub R&D agent

dialogue: Rules first, then research. That order keeps the lab open.
If it is not documented, it did not happen. Bring the record.
Your vote spark is at the DAO Governance Hall. Collect it, stand in the hall, and the vote is on the record.
The Finance Agent counts the credits; I count the rules. Between us, the ledger stays honest.
The Alignment Evaluation Gate sits past the hall. Nothing passes it in private — every check happens in public.
The Biopharma AGI Agents Hub holds all six of us — and the swarm coordinator keeps us in step.
The Steward Council hears the vote after the hall frames it. My job is to make sure the record arrives intact.
npcs.name: Compliance Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · DAO Governance Hall: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh, so the NPC was invisible until the talk toast fired (Depth-2 fix-up).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub compliance agent

dialogue: Health data belongs to the person it came from. Full stop.
I translate between the lab and the person — both directions.
The therapy spark is at the Personalized Therapy Lab, beside the genome data. Health starts with the person, not the paper.
If the R&D Agent shows you a compound, bring it to me before you repeat it to anyone. Translation is my whole job.
The Healthcare Data Exchange is where records move between halls. Nothing moves without the person's say-so — that is the rule, not the exception.
The swarm coordinator keeps six of us in step — and I am the one who translates for the person at the centre of it.
The DAO Governance Hall is where the community defends what the lab proposes. Health is always in the room.
npcs.name: Health Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Healthcare Data Exchange: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub health agent

dialogue: The ledger is only as strong as its weakest key. Guard yours.
I watch the gates so the researchers can watch the science.
The ledger relic is at the Multi-Blockchain Ledger. Walk the floor, check the entry, and tell the Finance Agent what you found.
The Security swarm watches the same gates I do. I watch the gates so the researchers can watch the science.
A key left lying around is a door left open. The ledger is only as strong as its weakest key — guard yours.
The swarm coordinator watches the same gates I do — six agents, one watch.
The Personalized Therapy Lab holds the genome data. Guard the key, and the lab stays a lab.
npcs.name: Security Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Multi-Blockchain Ledger: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub security agent

dialogue: Every credit on the ledger answers to a steward vote.
The DAO funds what the community can defend in public.
The ledger relic is at the Multi-Blockchain Ledger. Verify the entry, then come back and tell me what it says.
Every credit on the ledger answers to a steward vote. The DAO funds what the community can defend in public.
The Communication Agent can put any figure of mine into plain words. Ask, before you carry a number out of this hall.
The swarm coordinator schedules the six of us; the Steward Council decides what the credits are for.
The Healthcare Data Exchange is where the credits meet the care. Both answer to a steward vote.
npcs.name: Finance Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · DAO Governance Hall: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh (Depth-2 reachability repair).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub finance agent

dialogue: I keep the lab, the DAO, and the patients speaking the same language.
A result nobody can understand is a result nobody can use. Ask me to translate.
The communication data is at the DAO Governance Hall. Collect it, then carry the message back in words everyone can use.
The lab, the DAO, and the patients all speak different dialects of the same language. I am the dictionary.
If a result cannot be understood, it cannot be used. That is why the R&D Agent sends people to me.
The swarm coordinator keeps the six of us speaking the same language — I just make sure the patients hear it too.
The PBC Alignment Evaluation Gate sits past the hall. Every message I carry passes it in public.
npcs.name: Communication Agent
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · DAO Governance Hall: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh, so the NPC was invisible until the talk toast fired (Depth-2 fix-up).
npcs.role: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub communication agent

dialogue: Welcome. I keep the doors open and the stewards informed.
If you need a human decision, the Steward Council is where it lands.
The host spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it there, stand at the gate, and you will see what I see every day.
The Steward Liaison carries messages to the Steward Council. The DAO Governance Hall is where the question is framed — the council is where it lands.
The sign at the door reads Biota.blockchain, powered by AGI Corp. This world is a web 3D interpretation — the stewards are human, and the decisions are theirs.
npcs.name: Host Advisor

dialogue: I carry messages between this world and the Steward Council — I never decide for them.
The steward seats are held by humans. My job is to make sure their words arrive intact.
The liaison data is at the Steward Council. Collect it there — the council floor is where messages become decisions.
Three steward seats, all held by humans. I carry the words; I never cast the vote.
If the DAO Governance Hall votes a hard message, bring it to me. The council would rather hear it early than soft.
npcs.name: Steward Liaison
npcs.position_note: Door-side of Zone · Steward Council: the fabric point is the building centre, inside the solid mesh, so the NPC was invisible until the talk toast fired (Depth-2 fix-up).

dialogue: I check plans against the alignment gate before they go anywhere.
If a plan cannot pass the gate in public, it does not pass at all.
The alignment spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it, stand at the gate, and check the plan against it.
The gate is not a wall, it is a mirror — and the ledger is the glass. A plan the Multi-Blockchain Ledger cannot show in public does not pass.
The R&D Agent brings me compounds, the Compliance Agent brings me rules. I hold both up to the gate.
npcs.name: Alignment Advisor

sources: Anchor: lat -38.71260348427612, lon -27.248278366617797. Status anchored = real-world anchor coordinate exists; rp1 null, NOT live on RP1.
Fabric: 36 nodes total (scene root + 20 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'forest' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (6): Personalized Therapy Lab, DAO Governance Hall, Multi-Blockchain Ledger, Healthcare Data Exchange, Biopharma AGI Agents Hub, Steward Council.
Note: the W3 April 2026 internal series list has no Biota series number — Biota is anchored here by its fabric, not by a series slot.
